messages.subject: CONSTRAINB + multipleGroup
parts:
Hi all,

I have a total of 72 items and three groups, each one answering a specific test ), such that:

Items 1-22: presented only to group 1
Items 23-30: presented to groups 1 and 2
Items 31-42: presented only to group 2
Items 43-52: presented to groups 2 and 3
Items 53-72: presented only to group 3

How would be the sintaxe for "mirt.model" + "multipleGroup"  in this case, since I want o to keep fixed the items acros the groups (they were presented)?

Thanks,

Best,

Caio

messages.subject: Re: CONSTRAINB + multipleGroup
parts:
Assuming your group names are G1, G2, and G3 in the group factor: 

model <- "
F[G1] = 1-22
F[G1, G2] = 23-30
F[G2] = 1-42
F[G2, G3] = 43-52
F[G3] =  53-72"

So pretty much a copy-paste of your initial specification. HTH.

Phil
